note: Hand-picked frames from the development asset. Guids and names here are neutral placeholders; the design they came from is not public. No Figma export ships with this repo, so level 4 has no oracle and frames get levels 1-2 plus the coverage scan. Recreate design.fig with: cp figma-input/sample.fig fixtures/sample/design.fig, and drop your own exports into exports/ to enable levels 3-4.
